RFC 4301 Section 7.1: "If the SA will carry traffic for specified protocols, the selector set for the SA MUST specify the port fields (or ICMP type/code or Mobility Header type) as ANY." Prior verdict enforced. selectorPort now takes the side (tsSelector) instead of (child, local); childPolicies picks local/remote by SelectorsLocalIsTSi exactly as the old side choice did, and the ANY/single/OPAQUE mapping is byte-identical. The units changed only to childPolicies(rfc4301ChildWith(pair), dir)[0]; rfc4301ChildWith carries one pair, so the slice holds one policy. Each negotiated pair now gets its own protocol and ports, so a multi-pair SA no longer inherits pair 0's. Positive asserts UpperProto 17 and both ports ANY in both directions; negative asserts no ExactPortMatch(8080/9090/0) leaks under ANY. PASS at HEAD. Verdict stands.
